```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("biomaRt")
}
library(biomaRt)

ensembl_ids <- rownames(laugh)

mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")  # use mmusculus/rnorvegicus for mouse/rat

# Get mapping
gene_map <- getBM(
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
  values = ensembl_ids,
  mart = mart
)

# Remove empty mappings
gene_map <- gene_map[gene_map$hgnc_symbol != "", ]

# Make sure mapping is 1-to-1 (remove duplicates if needed)
gene_map <- gene_map[!duplicated(gene_map$ensembl_gene_id), ]

# Subset Seurat object to those with mappings
laugh <- subset(laugh, features = gene_map$ensembl_gene_id)

# Replace rownames with gene symbols
rownames(laugh) <- gene_map$hgnc_symbol[match(rownames(laugh), gene_map$ensembl_gene_id)]

```

```{r}
# Extract assay matrix (RNA assay, "data" slot)
rna_data <- GetAssayData(laugh, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")

# Match ENSEMBL IDs to gene symbols
ensembl_ids <- rownames(rna_data)
mapped_symbols <- gene_map$hgnc_symbol[match(ensembl_ids, gene_map$ensembl_gene_id)]

# Remove entries with no gene symbol
keep <- !is.na(mapped_symbols) & mapped_symbols != ""
rna_data <- rna_data[keep, ]
mapped_symbols <- mapped_symbols[keep]

# Ensure unique gene symbols
rna_data <- rna_data[!duplicated(mapped_symbols), ]
rownames(rna_data) <- mapped_symbols

data_mat   <- GetAssayData(laugh, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
# Match & clean both matrices
gene_map <- gene_map[gene_map$hgnc_symbol != "" & !duplicated(gene_map$ensembl_gene_id), ]

# Map to gene symbols
symbol_map <- gene_map$hgnc_symbol[match(rownames(counts_mat), gene_map$ensembl_gene_id)]
keep <- !is.na(symbol_map) & symbol_map != ""

# Filter and rename both
counts_mat <- counts_mat[keep, ]
data_mat <- data_mat[keep, ]
symbol_map <- symbol_map[keep]

# Remove duplicated symbols
nondup <- !duplicated(symbol_map)
counts_mat <- counts_mat[nondup, ]
data_mat <- data_mat[nondup, ]
rownames(counts_mat) <- symbol_map[nondup]
rownames(data_mat) <- symbol_map[nondup]

# Create new Seurat object
laugh_symbol <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts_mat, meta.data = laugh@meta.data)

# Add the normalized data manually to the "data" slot
DefaultAssay(laugh_symbol) <- "RNA"
laugh_symbol[["RNA"]]@data <- data_mat



# Optionally transfer metadata / reductions if needed
laugh_symbol@meta.data <- laugh@meta.data
laugh_symbol@reductions <- laugh@reductions  # if PCA/UMAP etc. were run before
laugh_symbol
```
